The router picks the top 2 routed experts for each token and supplies the gate weights g_i that scale their outputs; the shared expert E_s always runs, and the weighted sum is added back to the residual stream. Selected experts are drawn in full ink and unselected ones ghosted; the dashed edge is control, not data, so the selected experts read x directly and only their outputs are scaled. The block replaces the MLP of the residual-stream figure; five routed experts and top-2 routing are illustrative, and the selection shown is for one token.
